references.context: Soft-plunge through the currently lit star rollover.
references.label: Moving star rollover
references.description: Time a soft plunge so the ball crosses the lit star.

references.context: Use the seven-target bank above the zipper flippers.
references.label: Upper target bank
references.description: Hit only the targets shown by the current pattern.

references.context: Collect a lit Olympus Bonus at the upper saucer.
references.label: Upper saucer
references.description: Collect the built Olympus Bonus here when lit.

references.context: The left orbit advances end-of-ball Bonus X.
references.label: Left orbit
references.description: Advance Bonus X to 5x; later shots score 50,000.

references.context: The right orbit advances its own fixed award.
references.label: Right orbit

references.context: Complete the left 1-2-3 standups in order.
references.label: Left 1-2-3 targets
references.description: Complete these in order to advance Colossus.

references.context: Complete the right four-bank as the alternate Colossus route.
references.label: Right four-bank
references.description: Complete the bank to advance Colossus.

references.context: Shield of Gods controls the center post between the lower flippers.
references.label: Shield of Gods
references.description: Activate it with the extra cabinet button while uses remain.
